source.title: 14. Children and Adolescents: Standards of Care in Diabetes—2026
source.citation: American Diabetes Association Professional Practice Committee for Diabetes. 14. Children and adolescents: Standards of Care in Diabetes—2026. Diabetes Care 2026;49(Suppl. 1):S297–S320.

guideline_boundary: Formal ADA recommendations are panel/guideline statements represented as author_conclusion atoms tagged guideline_recommendation. Underlying-study findings are tagged secondary_reported_result and remain anchored to this Standards chapter; the chapter is not represented as if it enrolled study participants.
schema_gaps: The current LiteratureAtom schema has no guideline_recommendation atom kind, so formal recommendations use author_conclusion with descriptive tags.
ADA recommendation evidence grades are stored in tags because the schema has no dedicated grade field.
Guideline algorithms/tables use other atoms because the current schema has no dedicated workflow/table assertion kind.
extraction_limitations: The full ADA guideline-development methodology and evidence-grade definitions are in the separate Introduction and Methodology and are not part of dc26s014.pdf.
Bibliography entries are not atomized; all 251 are preserved in the reference task queue.
All atoms remain needs_review because this run does not represent independent human verification.
No external current-practice or regulatory verification was used as evidence for the artifacts because @VERIFY was not activated.
protocol_version_note: The project file is named summary-evaluation-appraisal-protocol-v4-compact.md, while its internal heading identifies Integrated Compact v3. The v4-named project source was treated as governing and the naming mismatch was recorded rather than silently reconciled.
